total_model.summary: Model projects 46.2 total points (LA 27, LAC 19). Biggest factors: Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (lowers total 1.7), Combined quarterback ratings (raises total 0.8), Natural grass field (raises total 0.7). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
